title: BACKND Base region / location
summary: IP-based location/region info cached in the SDK: UpdateLocationProperties refreshes the cached country info, and get-my-region reads it. Caching is applied at login/token-reissue; auto-load can be enabled via inspector or BackendCustomSetting (autoLoadLocationProperties).
capabilities: route location/region questions to update vs read flows
explain that cached location applies at login/token-reissue
note auto-load configuration and VPN caveats
prerequisites: Network allows IP-based geolocation (VPN may prevent it)
common_pitfalls: Expecting location to update mid-session without login/token-reissue
Assuming accurate region when a VPN is in use
Forgetting to enable auto-load when needed
verification_required_for: exact method names and LocationProperties fields
verification_strategy: Use https://docs.backnd.com plus the source route before generating location code.
Confirm caching timing and setting names upstream.
public_notes: Location is IP-based and applied at login/token-reissue; VPN can break detection.
Related country enum is in the country-code topic.
